name: code-comparison
blurb: Side-by-side code comparison with syntax highlighting and diff notation.
description: Before/after code comparison using Shiki with notation transformers for highlighting, diffs, and focus lines. Theme-aware and supports custom highlight color. Hover effects for focus.
use_when: Showing code refactors, migrations, or before/after examples in documentation.
avoid_when: When full code editing is needed or when code is very long.
a11y: Focus highlighting helps visual comparison. Both panels are selectable text.
